sources.entry: Open Agent API - Run a coding agent on your own machine and call it from an existing app, with a local demo that needs no model account. #opensource

summary.one_liner: Open Agent API is a self-hosted gateway that publishes complete agents (with their own tools, permissions, and sign-in) behind OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini compatible endpoints, so an existing SDK client can call an agent by name.
summary.what_it_does: The gateway exposes agents as API endpoints: a caller sends a request with a Base URL, an API key, and an agent name in the model field, and the agent runs a multi-turn tool loop as one task. It accepts requests over OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses, Claude Messages, Gemini generateContent, and MCP, with streaming supported. Agents can be the built-in kernel (defined in OAA-Lang or JSON and backed by a model provider) or local CLI agents such as Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity, and ACP agents that the user already has installed and signed in. Runs that need sensitive actions pause for approval, which can be given from the console, the terminal, or an approve-scoped key. The README also describes cancel, resume, idempotency keys, a console, and an optional developer platform with credit-based billing. A local demo runs the kernel in-process with a deterministic model and no gateway.
use_cases: expose a local coding agent to an existing app via API
call an agent instead of a raw model from OpenAI SDK code
require human approval before an agent takes sensitive actions
wrap Codex or Claude Code behind one API for several apps
run scheduled or webhook-triggered agent tasks
try an agent locally without a model account using the demo
how_to_run: git clone the repository and install dependencies with npm from a Node.js 24.18+ source checkout
stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini SDK compatibility
notable: Swap only Base URL, API key, and model name in an existing OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini SDK client to call a full agent
Durable approvals: runs needing review pause in requires_action and can be approved from console, terminal, or API
Wraps installed local CLI agents (Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity, ACP agents) without extracting their credentials
Compatibility lab runs real SDK packages against an offline gateway, reporting 456 scenarios
Local deterministic demo (npm run demo) runs without any gateway or model account
caveats: Source route requires Node.js 24.18 or newer; the package is marked private and not published on npmjs.org
External agents inherit host privileges unless sandboxed (POSIX only); Windows has no process sandbox per the README
Desktop installers are not code-signed or Apple-notarized; single SQLite gateway only, with no clustering or Postgres
